scripts.api:dev: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir apps/api
scripts.test: pnpm test:shell && pnpm test:desktop && pnpm test:api
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @0186/desktop lint && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @0186/desktop typecheck && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app
